title: US lifts export controls on Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
summary: Commerce Secretary Lutnick notified Anthropic no export licence is needed; in exchange Anthropic agreed to pre-release government testing, rapid jailbreak reporting and joint safety standards. Fable 5 returned globally from Jul 1 with a new jailbreak classifier.
reason: Ends an 18-day shutdown (imposed Jun 12 over national-security/jailbreak concerns) with a new de facto government pre-release testing regime: control mechanism up, frontier capability back online.

title: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 5 as default model
summary: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5, its most agentic Sonnet, approaching Opus 4.8 performance at lower cost, as the default for Free and Pro users.

title: Anthropic launches Claude Science and preclinical drug-discovery program
summary: Anthropic released a research workbench linking Claude to scientific databases and genomics tools, plus its own drug-discovery effort.

title: Google misses June target for Gemini 3.5 Pro
summary: Gemini 3.5 Pro stayed in limited enterprise preview past Google's June 30 target, with reports citing token efficiency and long-horizon reasoning problems.
